The '''AA-9 Coruscant freighter''', also known as the '''Botajef Freighter-Liner''', was a massive freighter model used to transport large groups of people to and from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:HutteseShipMarkings.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] computer panel in the main hold of an AA-9 freighter owned by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]]]]
AA-9 freighters were built at the [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]]. The vessels were considered a common bulk freighter across the whole of the galaxy and were one of the largest freighter models in the Republic at the time of their creation. They employed [[Type Dyne-2577 sublight drive]]s in a Triad Drive Array. They were equipped with cargo hatches along the dorsal and keel areas in order for quick and simple loading. They were commonly utilized to move bulk goods, liquid tankage and inert cargo between many star ports including those of Coruscant. As a result of the dislocation of populations by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] converted a number of these freighters into makeshift passenger transports, with the middle deck modified to carry 30,000 people.<ref name="FF" />

==History==
One ship, the [[Jendirian Valley/Legends|''Jendirian Valley'']], transported [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after a failed assassin attempt on Amidala's life.

[[File:Republic_on_Aereen.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gunship transports landing on [[Aereen]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ships of this kind were used as cargo transports for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and were often gathered into convoys, with added protection given by dedicated Republic warships. They were also used as troop transports by the clone army itself. The civilian version was in use at least 20 years later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] used such craft for transportation of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]].

==Variations==
===Gunship Transport===
[[File:Gunship_transport.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A gunship transport]]
The '''Gunship Transport''' was a non-combat unit used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to ferry troops and equipment around the battlefield. The transport was capable of spatial and atmospheric flight and was unarmed.
